Timed multishot, two segments across two fixed camera setups. One cut, at 1.8s, HARD CUT; the camera does not cut on its own.

OPTICS

CAMERA
Two locked setups with a 1 cm handheld breath; within every segment the frame holds perfectly still — all movement happens inside the frame, never by the camera. Setup 1, the close-up on Adil: level horizon, face and chest in frame, the warm lamp glow and the poster wall behind him, the desk zone outside this frame — identical to the closing frame of the previous shot; the frame stays fixed while he rises fully to his feet inside it. Setup 2, the wide two-shot: the scene's established master — the sofa seen from the front in the left third with the plush jaguar on the blanket at its left end, Adil standing in front of the sofa's right cushion, desk and Cindy in the right third with the glowing box at her chest, open floor and the dark doorway in the middle third, the macaw on its cage dome at the far left edge, the coffee table edge at the lower left, ceiling out of frame, each character smaller than a quarter of the frame's width. ACTION
